thread:
amanda: rolled out canary -> eu1 for release v2026.03.19 (PR #4123). kicking off post-deploy smoke + kv/health probes. keeping traffic at 5% for 15m. please watch p95 and kv-warmup.

deploy-bot: Deploy complete on eu1-canary (pool: redwood-dedicated-eu1). Canary traffic: 5%. Autoscale: enabled.

smoke-bot: running synthetic checks:
- /health (200) on 3/4 hosts
- /v1/generate (200) but p95=560ms (baseline ~120ms)
- kv-warmup success: 2/4 hosts warmed

jordan_sre: seeing p95 spike on the same host group as last week's warmstart. any config changes in runtime?

amanda: nothing intentional. release only updated the model variant and pinned quantization profile to q4_8.

raj: congrats on rollout. quick idea: maybe prefix caching didn't prime due to smaller canary traffic. can we temporarily increase synth qps to warm caches?

luis: we have a CI change that reduced the warmup fanout to limit noise. that could explain fewer KV warms. reverting now would require a small patch.

emily: +1 to warming. but worried about load on canary hosts. propose: run targeted warmup with smaller parallelism and monitor p95.

jordan_sre: recommendation: hold staggered rollout. pin routing to previous model variant (v2026.02.28) for 10m while we run warmup. if p95 stays high after warming, rollback.

amanda: ok hold. switching pin now. tagging on-call.

deploy-bot: Routing pin applied: all canary requests -> model v2026.02.28 for service=inference-eu1.

smoke-bot: running targeted warmup (script):
```
for i in {1..40}; do curl -sS -X POST https://eu1.api.redwood.local/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"warmup"}' >/dev/null &
done
wait
```

smoke-bot: warmup run complete. kv-warmup: now 4/4 hosts. /health: 4/4. /v1/generate p95: 130ms.

raj: warmup looked clean. p95 back to normal on pinned variant.

jordan_sre: decision: keep pin for now. we will not progress rollout until we have a small reproducer for the p95 regression on the new variant. open ticket for model perf regression with logs and traces.

amanda: filed ticket INF-7682 with traces and flamegraphs. added release note draft: "canary held due to transient p95 spike during model variant warmstart; investigating warmup fanout interaction"

emily: update release notes & changelog and mark the change window as extended by 20m.

luis: will prepare a tiny patch to increase warmup fanout for the model onboarding job; will test in staging.

amanda: thanks all. next steps: 1) keep pin until patch + reproduce 2) regroup in #eng-releases in 30m 3) if reproduce -> rollback full rollout, else resume with staggered increase and extended warmup.

raj: ack. :thumbsup:

jordan_sre: leaving note for postmortem if this recurs. tagging @oncall.

amanda: closing thread for now, will post updates. :eyes:
